integrity: Analytical derivation and standalone symbolic and finite numerical checks are supplied. Numerical eigenvalue samples are not substituted for proof. The source preprint public date comes from the arXiv version history. The result is not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Only the linear spectrum and local hyperbolic stability of the unique positive coexistence equilibrium are classified for negative modification strength and fixed equal pairwise magnitude two. Nonlinear behavior at imaginary crossings, cycle existence, global basins and population persistence remain unproved.
title: Exact reentrant coexistence stability in a dynamically modified three-species food web
